epics.name: Gameplay and Interface
epics.purpose: To improve how the game is played and watched in the browser, without changing its rules.

issues.title: Allow the movement trails to be shown or hidden
Allow the length of the movement trails to be chosen
Provide a fullscreen view of the arena
Mark the arena with coordinate labels
Provide a button that copies a text summary of the match
Remember the player's choices between visits

epics.name: Accessibility
epics.purpose: To make the game usable by more people, including those who use a keyboard only, a screen reader, a different colour scheme or a larger text size.

issues.title: Make keyboard focus clearly visible on every control
Allow the light or dark theme to be chosen by the player
Provide a colour palette suitable for colour-vision deficiency
Announce round events to screen readers
Ensure the page stays usable at 200% zoom and with larger text

epics.name: New Bodies
epics.purpose: To widen the choice of bodies, each with distinct physics, using the existing body registry. A new body is registered, described and checked by the existing fairness tests.

issues.title: Add a heavy body
Add a light body
Add a slippery body
Generate a comparison table of all registered bodies
Provide a command that reports the fairness figures of one body

epics.name: New Bots and Agents
epics.purpose: To widen the set of scripted opponents, so that players meet different styles of play.

issues.title: Show a short description of each bot in the player menu
Add a cautious runner
Add a chaser that anticipates the path of the runner
Add a bot that patrols along a fixed route
Add a bot that mirrors its opponent

epics.name: Data and Analysis Tools
epics.purpose: To help people understand the published match data with small, well-tested tools. These tools read data and write reports. They do not change the simulator. They are published only after the dataset is confirmed to be publicly downloadable, and each is tested with a small made-up example, so that no download is needed. The first issue provides a shared reader, and the others use it.
epics.reserve: Held in reserve: describe the contents of a planner file; export one game to a table of frames; export league standings to a spreadsheet file.

issues.title: Provide a shared reader for the dataset
Produce an inventory report of the dataset
Check dataset archives against the manifest
Report the distribution of game outcomes
Produce a matrix of results for each pairing of bots
Report how long games last before a tag
Draw the paths of one recorded game as an image

epics.name: Documentation and Tutorials
epics.purpose: To make the project easier to learn, in plain and correct language.
epics.reserve: Held in reserve: translations of the quick-start guide.

issues.title: Write a glossary of the terms used in the game and the documentation
Write a page of frequently asked questions
Write a tutorial: "Your first body"
Write a tutorial: "Your first bot"
Write a guide to playing from another device on the same network
Refresh the screenshots and record a short gameplay clip

openEpic.name: Testing and Quality
openEpic.purpose: An open epic: it has no fixed tasks. Contributors propose sub-issues under a module issue and agree the scope with the maintainer.
